svg.title: APIN
svg.desc: APIN: a figure kneels in a vegetable field at dusk, lighting one cabbage leaf with a phone. Leaf-disease diagnosis for tomato, okra and brassica with calibrated confidence and a Grad-CAM heat map. Live on Hugging Face.

g.text: Photograph a tomato, okra or cabbage leaf and get a
diagnosis with calibrated confidence, a heat map of
where the model looked, and what to do about it.
